benchmark: Del Norte iGEM Plasmid Builder - designer.js correctness benchmark
frozen_note: This file is frozen input data. Expected values were derived by manually cross-referencing data/templates.json's slot/candidate lists against data/parts.json's id set, NOT by executing designer.js's fillTemplate()/design(). Do not regenerate this file from the tool's own output.
scoring_note: Only scope=='core' cases count toward Exact Construct Correctness (ECC) and the other primary/secondary metrics. scope=='bsub_readiness' cases are smoke tests reported separately under 'B. subtilis readiness' and never affect the core percentage. B. subtilis (bsub_secretion) validation is deferred until Task 1 adds real backbone parts. Synthetic branch-coverage fixtures for designer.js code paths that cannot be reached with real repository data live separately in synthetic_fixtures.json and are also excluded from every score in this file.
